`synthetic-score.heic` is an original, redistributable fixture created from
`tests.helpers.score_image()` using pillow-heif 1.8.1 at quality 90.
It contains only programmatically drawn lines, note-like marks and a gray oval.
It is covered by the project's MIT license. No user score is included.

The application ships the decode-only `pi-heif-decoder`; the fixture allows HEIC
regression checks without shipping an HEVC encoder.
